title: review follow-ups of PR #37185
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Filing gate: L1 follow-ups of a landed PR (one card per PR, items ticked) · Source: fleet (the seat repo:objectstack#4 L1 record 7153130491 on PR #37185, card #37080; the seat asked that this card be filed at landing)

PR #37185 merged (#37080). It moved the same-server `/api/` calls in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/**` and `ui/apps/console/src/**` onto `createAuthenticatedFetch`, and added the shrink-only ratchet `ui/packages/app-shell/src/sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`. Its L1 left two follow-ups.

## Items

- [ ] **N1 — the ratchet does not see through a fetch alias.** `flowDraftChecks.ts` builds `const doFetch = opts.fetchImpl ?? createAuthenticatedFetch()` and then calls `doFetch(…)`. Reverting that one conversion to a bare `fetch` alias would not turn the ratchet red. `DraftChangesPanel.flowChecks-34818` stays green either way, because it reads through `new Headers(…)`.
  - Do: teach the ratchet to follow a local alias bound to `fetch` / `globalThis.fetch`, or pin this call site directly.
  - Done when: a revert of that conversion to a bare cookie-only alias turns a pin red (measured by an ablation).
- [ ] **N4 — the `AiChatPage.tsx` allow-list row's reason is stale.** Its reason ("an open pull request edits this file") pointed at #37123, which merged on 2026-11-25 before #37185's merge base. The call is still bare, and the fence has lifted.
  - Do: convert the `AiChatPage.tsx` same-server call(s) onto `createAuthenticatedFetch` and remove its row from the shrink-only list.
  - Done when: the row is gone, the ratchet's exactness case passes, and a bearer-only pin covers the chat page read.

## Not in this card

- The same mechanism in the plugin packages, plus two app-shell reads the ratchet does not cover: #37225.
- The action-preview allow-list row: it stays exactly as it is. It is owned elsewhere, and this card does not touch it.

Grading: area:ux · Bug · minor (a test-instrument gap and one remaining cookie-only page read) · reach: the ratchet's own case (N1); the AI chat page under a bearer-only session (N4, read) · evidence read → p2, size XS; triage to confirm.

Business reason: the ratchet is what keeps the shell bearer-safe, and a gap in it lets the defect come back unseen. The chat page is the last listed shell read that a bearer-only user still cannot load for a reason that no longer holds.

Reader: zone a4-U, at a free slot, or whoever claims #37225, since both edit the ratchet.

Dedupe: `review follow-ups of PR #37185` → no hit; `flowDraftChecks alias ratchet` and `AiChatPage bearer` → no open card.
